integrity.claim_scope: All integers n>=3 and all admissible positive path edge probabilities
integrity.proof: Self-contained algebraic KKT certificate and exact global gap identity

scientific_limitations: Symmetric, uniform-stationary, irreducible nearest-neighbor path chains only
The even-order improvement over spectral minimax is asymptotically small, of order inverse squared order
Historical publication priority can be affected by unindexed equivalents of the explicit finite-path formula
No conclusion for nonsymmetric, weighted-stationary, or non-path chains
title: Parity-optimal Kemeny design on finite symmetric stochastic paths
